rules.sentence: CSF abnormalities are more significant than asymptomatic neurosyphilis (CSF usually shows 200-400 WBCs/microL or protein 100-200 mg/dL), and the CSF VDRL is almost always positive.
Meningovascular syphilis is defined as meningeal inflammation with endarteritis that predisposes the patient to early strokes and cerebrovascular pathology.
